strike.name: Strike
strike.desc: Melee hit on an adjacent unit or barrel.

splash.name: Splash
splash.desc: Soak a + shaped area with water. Puts out burning units.

wave.name: Wave
wave.desc: Straight jet: soaks its path, hits the first thing and pushes it 2 tiles.

zap.name: Zap
zap.desc: Strike one tile. Spreads through all connected water.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.desc: 3x3 shock. Any water touched carries it further.

firebolt.name: Firebolt
firebolt.desc: Burn one tile. Ignites oil, explodes barrels, boils water into steam.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: + shaped blaze. Burns everything it touches.

smash.name: Smash
smash.desc: Heavy melee hit on an adjacent tile.

fire_spit.name: Fire Spit
fire_spit.desc: Ranged fire glob. Needs line of sight when it fires.
